subject: SOC 2 evidence ownership & retention decision points — next steps
body:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@banknova.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@banknova.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Intro call recap — SOC 2 / retention questions

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap and a few follow-ups from the security team:

High-level pain points we described:
- We need a clear artifact map for SOC 2 controls that references where logs and evidence live (who on your side owns each artifact).
- Retention policy: our compliance requires 7 years for audit logs, and we need to understand how Redwood enforces retention and deletion for hosted vs private deployments.
- DPA/Crypto: we must confirm KMS/HSM options and whether keys can be customer-managed.
- Pen test evidence: we need to see the summary report and the timeline for the next external pentest.

Immediate asks from BankNova security:
1) A one-page SOC 2 evidence index that maps control IDs to file names and owners.
2) Confirmation of retention enforcement for audit logs (configurable per customer) and whether immutable retention is possible for archive windows.
3) DPA redline we circulated — we expect a comment on section 6 (Data processing and sub-processors).
4) A sanitized pen-test executive summary (odd items redacted is fine) plus the cadence for future tests.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Security — BankNova

---

On Mon, 9 Aug 2027 at 15:35, marissa_cole@redwood.ai wrote:
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@banknova.com>, Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@banknova.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:35:42 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence ownership & retention decision points — next steps

Elena — really appreciate the clear list. High level recap from our side and next steps below.

What we heard (confirming accuracy):
- BankNova requires 7-year retention for audit logs and an immutable archive option.
- You need a control-to-artifact mapping and explicit owners for evidence collection during attestations.
- Customer-managed keys are preferred for production data at rest; you need confirmation that Redwood supports KMS/HSM integration for Private and Dedicated deployments.
- You requested a sanitized pen-test executive summary and timing for the next external test.

Who on our side will own each deliverable:
- SOC 2 evidence index (owner: Ben Carter, Security Solutions) — deliverable: one-page mapping + folder of sample artifacts. Target: 2027-08-12 EOD.
- Retention + immutable archive spec (owner: Karthik Iyer, Platforms) — deliverable: short doc describing retention enforcement, retention lock options, and any region limitations. Target: 2027-08-13 midday.
- DPA redline response (owner: Kimberly Park, Legal) — deliverable: annotated DPA with comments on section 6 and sub-processor list. Target: 2027-08-11.
- Pen-test summary (owner: Ben Carter) — deliverable: sanitized executive summary + list of remediation status. Target: 2027-08-12.

Attachments I will send in the next email:
- Redwood SOC 2 evidence index (template)
- DPA redline checklist (legal playbook)
- Sample retention config screenshot (private deployment)

Open questions for BankNova (please confirm):
- Is the 7-year retention a hard requirement across all log types (access logs, application logs, audit trails), or are some logs scoped differently?
- Do you need immutable storage that we provision on Hosted, or would Dedicated/Private be acceptable if we can’t provide immutability in Hosted today?

Next call: propose 30 minutes on Thu 2027-08-12 to walk the artifacts (Ben + Karthik + Kimberly). Does 10:00 AM CEST work?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

---

On Mon, 9 Aug 2027 at 16:10, Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@banknova.com> wrote:
From: Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@banknova.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@banknova.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 16:10:05 +0200
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence ownership & retention decision points — next steps

Marissa — thanks, that looks good. Quick clarifications:
- The 7-year requirement applies to immutable audit trails and tamper-evident logs for customer activity. Application debug logs can be scoped to 1 year.
- We prefer customer-managed KMS for production data; Dedicated would be acceptable if Hosted cannot guarantee customer key ownership.
- 10:00 AM CEST on Thu 2027-08-12 works for Ben and Karthik to present.

Also attached a copy of our internal evidence intake template — will upload to your Drive link if helpful.

—Marco
Sr. IT Compliance Manager — BankNova

(attachment stub: banknova-evidence-template.xlsx)

---

On Mon, 9 Aug 2027 at 17:28, ben_carter@redwood.ai wrote:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@banknova.com>, Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@banknova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence ownership & retention decision points — next steps

Great to meet earlier — Ben here (Security Solutions). I’ll own the SOC 2 evidence index and the pen-test summary. Next steps from my side:

Action items (Ben):
- Compile evidence index + sample artifacts and place in shared Drive: target 2027-08-12 09:00 CEST.
- Produce sanitized pen-test executive summary (redactions for customer specifics): target 2027-08-12 12:00 CEST.
- Confirm scope of logs we can make immutable on Hosted; if not supported, provide migration path to Dedicated/Private with timeline.

Action items (Karthik):
- Document retention enforcement and immutable archive options (includes region limitations and storage class behavior).

Action items (Kimberly):
- Review DPA redline and provide annotations.

Note on attachments: I will upload the following as placeholders to the shared Drive folder: redwood-soc2-evidence-summary.pdf, pen-test-stub-report.txt. Kimberly will attach the DPA response as a DOCX.

Proposed agenda for Thu 2027-08-12, 10:00–10:30 CEST:
1) Five-minute intro + key requirements by BankNova security
2) Walk the SOC 2 evidence index (Ben)
3) Retention & immutability options (Karthik)
4) DPA redline timing and next legal touchpoints (Kimberly)
5) Agree on acceptance criteria and next steps

If that agenda looks good, I’ll create the Drive folder and invite BankNova.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Security Solutions — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0820
